svg.title: A complete mHC layer runs read, compute, write, and a Sinkhorn-constrained mix across six steps, bounding composite gain near 1.6 versus about 3000 for unconstrained HC.
svg.desc: Streams enter the layer, a non-negative read map compresses them into one vector for the attention or MLP block, a non-negative write map expands the output back into per-stream updates, and a Sinkhorn-projected residual mixing map combines the incoming streams before the update is added; only this last map is doubly stochastic, and the paper reports a composite backward gain near 1.6 at 27B scale versus about 3000 for unconstrained Hyper-Connections, at a cost of about 6.7 percent additional training time.
